title: Understanding the Estimator
text: To find the variance of the estimator, consider how the maximum outcome of a single roll of a die is determined. What are the possible outcomes?

title: Possible Outcomes
text: The possible outcomes of a single roll of a fair 6-sided die are $$1$$, $$2$$, $$3$$, $$4$$, $$5$$, and $$6$$. The maximum outcome is the highest number rolled.

title: Calculating the Variance
text: The variance of an estimator is calculated as the expected value of the squared deviation of the estimator from its expected value. Can you express this mathematically?

title: Expected Value of the Estimator
text: Calculate the expected value of the maximum outcome when rolling a fair 6-sided die once.

title: Variance Formula
text: Use the formula for variance: E[(X-E[X])**2], where X is the estimator. Substitute the expected value you calculated.

title: Multiple Choice Verification
text: Verify your calculated variance with the given multiple choice options.
